basic_info.description:
Welcome to your dream home in the heart of the Excelsior district of San Francisco! This inviting 3-bed, 2-bath residence boasts city views and offers a perfect blend of comfort and modern living.
An inviting space with abundant natural light accentuates the main-level living and dining areas. The updated kitchen features sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry, making it a chef's delight.  The main level includes two generously sized bedrooms, providing plenty of space for family and guests. The primary bedroom offers a quiet and relaxing retreat overlooking the rear patio. 
Downstairs, you will find a bonus space, perfect for a work-from-home office or multi-generational living as an ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit). This versatile area includes a separate entrance, making it ideal for extended family, guests, or even rental income potential.  Buyer to verify sq footage and legality of downstairs space.  Laundry under front stairs. 
Outside is a fenced and nicely landscaped yard, perfect for entertaining or enjoying the stunning downtown views of San Francisco. The Excelsior district offers a vibrant community with easy access to parks, shopping, dining, and public transportation.  Don't miss this opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco real estate.
